subject: Mutual plan: procurement onboarding & next steps (Kestrel Health)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual plan: procurement onboarding & next steps (Kestrel Health)

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on vendor onboarding / procurement milestones so we can get you live on Redwood Dedicated by the end of the month. Please confirm or flag anything we missed.

Summary of commitments and owners (draft):
- Milestone 1 — Vendor registration (Ariba/Coupa): Kestrel to open vendor request with Procurement. Deliverables: vendor POC name, Kestrel vendor type, and tax ID. Redwood to provide vendor profile and support submission. Target: 2026-12-07.
- Milestone 2 — W-9 and vendor packet: Redwood to submit executed W-9 and vendor packet (inc. SOC 2 pointer). Target: 2026-12-03.
- Milestone 3 — Banking / payment setup: Redwood to provide bank verification letter (we avoid transmitting full account numbers over email). Kestrel Finance to confirm payment terms (Net 45 default). Target: 2026-12-10.
- Milestone 4 — Contract signature & legal checklist: Redwood to send redline-friendly contract; Kestrel Legal to return signed agreement or redlines. Target close date: 2026-12-17 (proposed).
- Dependencies: Kestrel supplier creation in Ariba/Coupa; procurement questionnaire completion (if required); any enterprise security addendum requests to be surfaced early.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will attach our W-9 + vendor packet and a one-page MAP spreadsheet with owners and dates.
2) Liam / Procurement to confirm supplier POC and whether Kestrel requires a specific supplier type in Ariba (Software vs Services).
3) Schedule a 30-min Ariba setup call (if helpful) with your procurement admin + our ops lead.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf, W-9_RedwoodInference_20261201.pdf, MAP-draft-kestrel-20261217.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP once you confirm details.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: procurement onboarding & next steps (Kestrel Health)

Thanks, Ava — good call earlier. We can follow that plan. A few clarifications/questions from Procurement: 

- Supplier POC: I will loop Sophie Martin (cc'ed) who manages supplier creation. Sophie — if you could confirm whether Kestrel needs Redwood to register as a "Software" vendor or "Professional Services" that would speed things up.
- W-9: please send the completed W-9 and vendor packet; procurement will attach it to the supplier request.
- Banking info: Finance prefers a bank verification letter and vendor remittance address; we do not accept bank account numbers by email. ACH setup will be completed after contract + vendor creation.
- If you are registered in Ariba already, send the vendor ID; otherwise Sophie will create the supplier record after she receives the W-9 and tax ID.

Target close date: the team is aiming to have vendors created by 12/10 so that contracts and onboarding can proceed. If you can get W-9 and packet over by EOD tomorrow (12/02), Sophie can start the profile.

I'll wait for the docs and the MAP spreadsheet.

Regards,
Liam O'Neil
Director, Platform Partnerships
Kestrel Health
liam.oneil@kestrelhealth.com

- MAP: attached MAP-draft-kestrel-20261217.xlsx — note updated target signature 2026-12-22 per internal note.

Proposed Ariba onboarding call: Tues 2026-12-07 at 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET — 30 minutes, include Sophie + your procurement admin + Ben + our Ops lead (Marissa). I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Let me know if any other docs are needed.
